source: Nuke's knob class for each knob: AColor_Knob (one slider that splits into r g b a) and WH_Knob (one slider that splits into w h), as Nuke writes them in .nk scripts (for example `multiply {1 1 1 1}`, `size {4 4}`) and as the Nuke Python API names them (nuke.AColor_Knob, nuke.WH_Knob). The Reference Guide's tables do not state knob classes, so this table is not read from the guide.
status: Curated, not exhaustive. Only knobs whose class is long-established are listed; a node that is not here has no splits component and is not penalised. To be confirmed against a Nuke install (scripts from tools/make_nuke_reference_pack.py can print each node's knob classes).
